items.briefing:
Home batteries and solar systems are becoming a cybersecurity concern for Australian organisations, as connected energy devices may now fall under compliance obligations — if your workplace uses these, check whether they meet current security standards. Separately, Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger defences against scams, signalling that regulatory pressure in this space is likely to increase for Australian businesses.

AI tools are also creating new security challenges locally, with traditional access controls struggling to keep pace with automated AI systems. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI-powered tools, ask your IT team whether access permissions have been reviewed recently to account for them.

featured.title: Australia's home batteries are now a cybersecurity compliance isue
featured.summary: Millions of rooftop batteries are now subject to mandatory cyber standards as Canberra widens scrutiny of grid-connected home devices.
